d: An android with a lean, athletic build and a metallic grey face featuring glowing neon pink eyes. The figure wears a white naval peaked cap and a long white overcoat draped over a navy blue military tunic with a pink tie, gold buttons, a brown leather belt with a pouch, and a row of colorful service ribbons. The outfit is completed with white trousers and knee-high black leather boots, while the figure holds a black cane. BODY COLOR: metallic grey
